title: Janaki Nayakan
desc: Ram, a young boy, lives in a monastery waiting for Sita to return and take care of him. However, Sita returns, years later, but with an ulterior motive.

title: Radhakrishna
desc: When the forest department takes away the elephant, the child is left without his dearest friend. The young boy undertakes a journey to find the lost animal.

title: PK
desc: An innocent alien lands on Earth but loses his communication device. However, he meets Jaggu, a heartbroken reporter, and tries to find his device with her help.

title: Sivakasi
desc: Muthappa is forced to leave his house at a young age for a crime that his older brother, Udayappa, has committed. When he returns home, he learns about his brother's antics and decides to punish him.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.
